advisoryExceptions.reason: GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c (npm advisory 1241202) covers every release of sprintf-js, so no release fixes it. fsm pulls sprintf-js 1.0.3 in only through @polyspec/kit -> @microsoft/api-extractor -> @rushstack/ts-command-line -> argparse 1.0.10 -> sprintf-js, which formats the help and error texts of the api-extractor command with its own format strings; no input of a user reaches it. kit, orm and hyper accept the same advisory with the same reason.
advisoryExceptions.removalCondition: a release of sprintf-js fixes GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c, or @microsoft/api-extractor no longer depends on argparse; make dependency-review then reports the exception as stale
